description: Lists the branches of a differential database with their head snapshot and, for shared databases, their state relative to the S3 branch head.
example: SELECT branch_name, head_snapshot_id, remote_state FROM differential_branches('sales');

description: Takes a single-writer database's S3 branch heads over after a copy of the repository wrote them.
Collects local data that no snapshot, branch, pin or pending export references any more.
Creates an independent database from a snapshot of another one, on the same data path and sharing its data.
Returns free pages of the repository's metadata store to the file system.
Creates a writable branch from a snapshot, sharing all data with it.
Checkpoints an attached writable branch and publishes it as an immutable snapshot with optional commit metadata; exports it to S3 and, for shared databases, moves the S3 branch head.
example: SELECT snapshot_id, export_state FROM differential_create_snapshot('sales', name => 'v1', message => 'first load');

description: Returns the snapshot an attachment reads, or the latest snapshot of the attached branch or database.
Lists the databases of the differential repository with their data path and writer mode.
example: SELECT database_name, data_path, writers FROM differential_databases();

description: Removes files in local pools that no mapping references, left behind by crashes.
Preserves a detached branch's contents as a snapshot and drops the branch (in a shared database, for every writer).
Drops the local copy of snapshots whose S3 export completed; they are then read through S3.
example: SELECT snapshot_id FROM differential_evict_snapshots('sales', versions => [1], dry_run => true);

description: Retires snapshots selected by version list and/or age so their local data can be collected; S3 exports remain.
example: SELECT snapshot_id FROM differential_expire_snapshots('sales', versions => [1], dry_run => true);

description: Copies an offline native DuckDB file into a new differential database and publishes it as snapshot 1.
Lists the durable operation records of the repository, used to replay requests by request_id.
example: SELECT kind, state, snapshot_id FROM differential_operations();

description: Lists the repository's storage locations (metadata store, local pools, S3 locations) with their S3 configuration and credential source, never credentials.
Copies an exported snapshot from S3 into a new writable differential database, verifying every chunk.
Lists the branch heads exported to an S3 location, each with the path to ATTACH its latest snapshot.
Reconciles a diverged branch of a shared database with its S3 head, keeping local work as a new branch or as a local snapshot.
example: SELECT kept_snapshot_id, kept_branch FROM differential_resolve_conflict('team', keep => 'branch');

description: Resets a detached branch to a snapshot after preserving its current contents as a snapshot.
example: SELECT snapshot_id, preservation_snapshot_id FROM differential_restore('sales', 1, branch => 'dev');

description: Lists why each stored database image is retained (snapshots, branches, pins, exports).
Finishes pending S3 exports of a database (all, or one snapshot) and republishes its branch heads.
Lists every snapshot of a differential database (for a shared database also other writers' snapshots, read from S3) with commit metadata, publication and S3 export state.
example: SELECT snapshot_id, snapshot_name, export_state FROM differential_snapshots('sales');

description: Reports the extension's capabilities, durability profiles, limits and last background publication error as capability/status rows.
Returns storage, S3, cache and timing counters of the repository and process as metric/value rows.
example: SELECT metric, value FROM differential_storage_stats() WHERE metric = 'local_payload_bytes';

description: Lists the advisory 'being written' markers of a shared database in S3: which hosts are writing which branches.
example: SELECT branch_name, host, live FROM differential_writers('team');
